result.query: I want something like Fusion 360 for 3D CAD with an AI generative design helper on my Mac

picks.name: FreeCAD
picks.why: FreeCAD covers 100% of your must-haves, runs on your platform, open source (LGPL-2.0-or-later). A free option for what you would use Autodesk AutoCAD for.

gaps.label: DWG file support
gaps.workaround: Convert DWG to DXF with the free ODA File Converter (freeware), which FreeCAD can call.

picks.name: LibreCAD
picks.why: LibreCAD covers 0% of your must-haves, runs on your platform, open source (GPL-2.0-only). A free option for what you would use Autodesk AutoCAD for.

gaps.label: Parametric 3D modeling
gaps.workaround: Use FreeCAD for 3D parts and LibreCAD for 2D sheets.
